hotels.title: Idyllic Thai Escape in Coastal Khao Lak with Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Enter a world of cascading waterfalls and dazzling turquoise pools with a stay at The Waters Khao Lak, part of the award-winning Katathani Collection. Accept relaxation beyond imagination - snooze late before taking breakfast at Amici Italian Bistro, spend the afternoon sipping cocktails at swim-up The Bubble Bar or rejuvenate at the onsite Sila Spa. When you’re ready to explore, Khao Lak abounds in sleepy golden beaches, hopping bars and magnificent national parks.
